aim_prompt: Aim at the water in Terraria and cast again — that click is saved as the cast point.
auto_drink_watch_all: Press when the Fishing or Sonar potion buff ends
auto_drink_watch_crate: Press when the Crate potion buff ends
auto_drink_watch_hint: Quick Buff is pressed when the chosen buff expires. Potions must be in the inventory.
auto_drink_buffs_missing: Auto drink could not find player buff slots. Stay in the world and press Start again.
projectile_probe_file: Projectile probe writing {path} (2s window after hook, recast, and a manual cast over Terraria).
theme_restart: Restart application to apply new theme.
hook_started: Memory hook starting. Equip a rod and cast once in Terraria.
mem_scanning_heap: Not on RX pages — scanning the .NET JIT heap (this can take up to a minute)...
mem_calibrating: Calibrating the bobber: equip a rod and cast into water once.
mem_calibrate_timeout: No cast seen — running without bobber verification.
mem_not_running: Terraria is not running. Launch the game, enter a world, cast once, then press Start.
mem_need_x86: Terraria is running as 64-bit. This bot only supports the default 32-bit Steam build. Remove -autoarch from launch options.
mem_sig_missing: FishingCheck signature not found. Cast the rod so the bobber is in the water, then press Start again. Keep the bot running — the heap scan can take a minute.
mem_context_null: Found FishingCheck but fishing context is empty. Cast once, wait a second, then press Start again.
mem_player_missing: Found the fishing hook but not the local player object. Stay in the world (don't be on the menu) and press Start again.
mem_reel_retrying: Bobber still in water, retrying the reel ({name}).
mem_reel_failed: Reel did not register. Reset the cast point with the Cast point button.
mem_reel_failed_recast: Reel did not register and the bobber is gone — recasting.
mem_recast_failed: Recast did not register. Retrying the recast click.
mem_anim_dead: Item animation is unreadable (memory shift) — running off the bite signal instead. Catches and line snaps are still logged.
mem_dunk_unavailable: Bobber dunk is unreadable (memory shift) — switching to the item-id bite signal. Fishing continues, but bites may register a moment later.
mem_safe_stop: Recast stopped for safety ({reason}). Mouse button released. Press Start to continue.
mem_focus_failed: Could not focus Terraria. Run the game and the bot at the same privilege level (both normal, or both as administrator).
